s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent episodes of loss of consciousness, visual disturbances, and headaches with associated vertigo, dizziness, and postural weakness, suggesting a complex vascular and neurological presentation
salient_findings: Recurrent blackouts
Blurring of vision and moderate frontal headaches
Vertigo, dizziness, palpitations, and postural weakness
Deficient pulses in both upper limbs
Bruit audible over the left subclavian fossa
Optic-disk cupping with irregular margins in the right eye
key_facts: Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate at 35 mm/hr
Microcytosis and hypochromasia on red-cell indices
Normal serum iron, total iron-binding capacity, transferrin, antinuclear antibodies, electrocardiogram, echocardiogram, and electroencephalogram
Computed tomography angiogram showing diffuse intimal thickening and narrowing at the origins of major arteries

raw.syndrome_frame: Recurrent episodes of loss of consciousness, visual disturbances, and headaches with associated vertigo, dizziness, and postural weakness, suggesting a complex vascular and neurological presentation
salient_findings: Recurrent blackouts

key_facts: Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate at 35 mm/hr
Microcytosis and hypochromasia on red-cell indices

Computed tomography angiogram showing diffuse intimal thickening and narrowing at the origins of major arteries

differentials: Primary angiitis of the central nervous system
Hereditary endotheliopathy with retinopathy, nephropathy, and stroke
per_call: Primary angiitis of the central nervous system
Hereditary endotheliopathy with retinopathy, nephropathy, and stroke

shortlist.label: Takayasu arteritis
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse intimal thickening and narrowing at the origins of major arteries, consistent with large vessel vasculitis

shortlist.label: Moyamoya disease
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent episodes of loss of consciousness, visual disturbances, and headaches with associated vertigo, dizziness, and postural weakness, suggesting a complex vascular and neurological presentation

shortlist.label: Giant cell arteritis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate and abnormal liver tests, which can be associated with large vessel vasculitis

shortlist.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
shortlist.why_kept: Anemia, elevated serum ferritin, and abnormal liver tests, which can be associated with systemic vasculitis

shortlist.label: Subclavian steal syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Bruit audible over the left subclavian fossa and deficient pulses in both upper limbs, consistent with subclavian artery stenosis or occlusion
